cropNote: Canvas can use fractional cell size 313.5. Integer bounds use floor(i*dimension/4), last edge=image dimension. Per-cell foregroundBounds are in absolute atlas pixels, exclusive right/bottom. Preserve common scale across frames; use whole cells or normalize anchors.
recommendedKeyPredicate: r > 120 && b > 120 && g < r * 0.60 && g < b * 0.60; account for antialiased edges
foregroundBoundsNote: Read-only approximate foreground bounds exclude near-magenta and isolated components smaller than 24 pixels.
recommendedCropNote: Generated atlas placement is approximate. Use spriteBounds over full cell when extracting, because a few sprites extend 1–8 pixels beyond a nominal row/cell boundary; maintain per-mode scale and normalize anchors. Bounds include assigned wake components, exclusive right/bottom.
